title: Breathwork: Diaphragm & Lung Capacity
summary: 15 min of breath training: wake up the diaphragm, open the ribs, then 30 resisted inhales (the IMT dose shown to build inspiratory strength), slow-paced breathing to finish.

steps.name: Supine belly breathing
steps.cue: On your back, knees bent, one hand on chest, one on belly. Inhale through the nose so only the belly hand rises; exhale slowly. Chest stays quiet.

steps.name: Crocodile breathing
steps.cue: Face down, forehead on hands. Breathe into the floor: feel the belly and low back/sides push out. Long, relaxed exhale.

steps.name: Side-lying rib breaths (left side up)
steps.cue: Lie on your right side, left hand on the lower ribs. Inhale to push the ribs into your hand, sideways and up. Exhale fully, ribs drop.

steps.name: Side-lying rib breaths (right side up)
steps.cue: Roll to your left side, right hand on the lower ribs. Inhale to push the ribs into your hand; exhale fully.

steps.name: Thoracic expansion with arm reach
steps.cue: Seated tall. Inhale as both arms sweep overhead, filling the upper chest last. Brief pause at the top, then exhale as arms lower.

steps.name: Weighted belly breathing
steps.cue: On your back with a book or 2–5 lb weight on the belly. Lift it with each nasal inhale, lower it slowly on the exhale. Ribs stay down.

steps.name: Resisted inhales
steps.cue: ~6 breaths per set (30 total). Trainer at ~50% of max, or inhale through a straw/tight pursed lips: sharp, full, hard inhale; slow, easy exhale. Stop if dizzy.

steps.name: Pursed-lip exhales
steps.cue: Inhale through the nose for 2–3 counts; exhale through pursed lips for twice as long, steady and complete. Like cooling soup.

steps.name: Resonance breathing (6/min)
steps.cue: Seated. In through the nose for 5 seconds, out for 5 seconds, belly-led, smooth and quiet. No breath holds.

steps.name: 90/90 hip-lift breathing
steps.cue: On your back, feet on a wall, hips and knees at 90°. Tilt the pelvis so the low back is flat. Inhale into the back ribs; exhale fully until the abs engage.
